description: This PHP class represents the entity 'LeaveEntitlementType' in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_leave_entitlement_type' database table. It defines properties for id, name, and whether the entitlement type is editable, with getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementType
classes.description: Entity class mapped to the leave entitlement type table, representing the types of leave entitlements (e.g., vacation, sick leave). Contains properties for id, name, and editability with appropriate ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave entitlement type.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the leave entitlement type is editable.

methods.name: setEditable
methods.description: Sets whether the leave entitlement type is editable.
